versions.subject: Merge PR #5656 from @0xbcf - Suspicious Process Suspension via WERFaultSecure through EDR-Freeze
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image: 'C:\Windows\System32\WerFaultSecure.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' /h '
        - ' /pid ' # Antimalware or EDR process pid will be after this line
        - ' /tid '
        - ' /encfile '
        - ' /cancel '
        - ' /type '
        - ' 268310'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="C:\\Windows\\System32\\WerFaultSecure.exe" CommandLine="* /h *" CommandLine="* /pid *" CommandLine="* /tid *" CommandLine="* /encfile *" CommandLine="* /cancel *" CommandLine="* /type *" CommandLine="* 268310*"
